### contractF64Overflows

Whether decimal text lies past binary64's largest finite value, so it
rounds to an infinity (IEEE 754-2019 §7.4).

```ts
function contractF64Overflows(text: string): boolean
```

<scalar-field name="text" type="string" required>

f64 text

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="boolean">

true for decimal text that reads as an infinity

</scalar-field>
